queries.name: union_return_payloads
queries.sql: SELECT union_value(s:='1')::UNION(s VARCHAR,b BOOLEAN,i BIGINT,f DOUBLE), union_value(b:=true)::UNION(s VARCHAR,b BOOLEAN,i BIGINT,f DOUBLE), union_value(i:=1::BIGINT)::UNION(s VARCHAR,b BOOLEAN,i BIGINT,f DOUBLE), union_value(f:=1::DOUBLE)::UNION(s VARCHAR,b BOOLEAN,i BIGINT,f DOUBLE)

queries.name: union_tag_distinctions
queries.sql: WITH t(v) AS (VALUES (union_value(i:=1::BIGINT)::UNION(s VARCHAR,b BOOLEAN,i BIGINT,f DOUBLE)), (union_value(f:=1::DOUBLE)::UNION(s VARCHAR,b BOOLEAN,i BIGINT,f DOUBLE)), (union_value(s:='1')::UNION(s VARCHAR,b BOOLEAN,i BIGINT,f DOUBLE)), (union_value(b:=true)::UNION(s VARCHAR,b BOOLEAN,i BIGINT,f DOUBLE))) SELECT union_tag(v), v FROM t ORDER BY v
